title: Classify a EUR battle relative directory
changes: Bound the independent 40d300 kind-2 relative directory used by the observed battle draw producer without classifying all of its target payloads.
validation: Wine battle-directory-dis-wine-nnfm38wz shows 0800720c retaining the low 16 bits of the selector, rejecting indices at or above the count at +2, reading kind at +0 and selecting 16-bit offsets relative to base+4 for kind 2. The byte at +1 is retained without an inferred meaning.

The exact EUR source has 103 entries and a 210-byte header/index, SHA-256 2c35f140bd943bb98726767c2a4032be05dee531b2c965b727a3dce867cd27da, disjoint from E148 declared sources. Wine battle-writer-observer-wine-q7qbukus observes selector 62 producing the managed 40dcba list; other selectors are source-only.
limitations: No complete target payload, selector-domain, caller, managed serving or cross-region claim. Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurement.
